supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The brow ridge extends laterally beyond the vertical plane of the outer eye corners.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast visible between the dark periocular/upper facial region and the significantly lighter, mottled pigmentation of the muzzle and chin.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: The lower lip is visible with moderate vertical thickness and a slight structural droop.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive mottled depigmentation and light-colored freckling across the muzzle and chin region.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent growth of white hair on the chin forming a distinct beard.
